name: Olivia Voldaren
aliases: Lady of our most illustrious house
description: Olivia Voldaren is an ancient vampire of Innistrad and progenitor of the Voldaren bloodline, known for her ambition to rule Innistrad.

description_citations.text: "Olivia Voldaren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

description_citations.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
description_citations.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

summary.text: Olivia Voldaren is an ancient vampire of Innistrad and progenitor of the Voldaren bloodline, known for her ambition to rule Innistrad.

citations.text: "Olivia Voldaren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
citations.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: Olivia became an immortal vampire by drinking the angel Marycz's blood in Shilgengar's Ritual.

citations.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: When Sorin sought her help against Nahiri, she agreed on condition that he destroy Avacyn, and she summoned her bloodline to Lurenbraum Fortress.

citations.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Call the Bloodline (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

bio.text: After Nahiri encased Sorin in stone, Olivia took his sword, proclaimed herself lord of Innistrad and left him trapped, and she also agreed a truce with Thalia at Thraben and killed Seeta.

citations.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.
"Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Years later she interrupted the Dawnhart witches' ritual, took Katilda hostage and obtained the Moonsilver Key when Arlinn threw it to her, which began the Eternal Night.

citations.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.
"Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.
"Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She demanded a nightly blood tithe from the people of Stensia and staged a wedding to Edgar Markov, aiming to unite the vampire bloodlines under her rule.

citations.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.
Olivia, Crimson Bride (Innistrad: Crimson Vow Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She also captured Sigarda, planning to control angels with Sigarda's blood bound with the Key.

citations.text: "Sigarda", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

bio.text: Sorin disrupted the wedding, Katilda's spirit freed Sigarda, and Olivia dropped the Key and fled with Edgar after impaling Arlinn, which ended the Eternal Night.

citations.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Eternal Night", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: She afterward left for Thunder Junction, where she became a queen of deadly subjects.

citations.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Recovering power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Olivia Voldaren", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: She is alive on Thunder Junction, where she has formed new alliances after failing to dominate Innistrad.

citations.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Outlaws of Thunder Junction/Commander", section "Most Wanted". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia drinks the angel Marycz's blood in Shilgengar's Ritual and becomes an immortal vampire.
timeline.quote: This turned her into an immortal vampire .

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren invents the Court of the Vampire King/Queen holiday.
timeline.quote: This disturbing three-day holiday was invented by Olivia Voldaren .

citation.work: A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires
citation.text: "A Planeswalker's Guide to Innistrad: Stensia and Vampires". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Nov 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: On Innistrad Liliana fails to exorcise the Veil's spirits, but harms Emrakul with the Veil's power.
timeline.quote: She failed.

citation.text: "Chain Veil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Markov Manor in ruins and seeks help from Olivia Voldaren.
timeline.quote: His search brought him to the remote estate of the powerful Olivia Voldaren

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri wounds and encases Sorin in stone at Markov Manor and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was wounded severely but managed to encase Sorin in stone.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren summons her bloodline to Lurenbraum Fortress at Sorin's appeal.
timeline.quote: At Sorin's appeal, Olivia Voldaren summoned the full might of her bloodline to gather at Lurenbraum Fortress.

citation.text: Call the Bloodline (Shadows over Innistrad, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin recruits Olivia against Nahiri; she requires that he kill Avacyn, and they raise a vampire army.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Olivia assembled a vampire army and went to war against Nahiri.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri defeats Sorin and encases him in stone; Olivia proclaims herself lord of Innistrad and takes his sword.
timeline.quote: Olivia proclaimed herself the new lord of Innistrad and took his sword from him.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia agrees to a truce with Thalia at Thraben and kills Seeta in front of her.
timeline.quote: Olivia killed Seeta - the Leader of the Sinpurged, right in front of Thalia.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben, empowered by Traft's geist, Thalia fights Eldrazi; Sigarda rescues her from Brisela and they defeat the fused sisters.
timeline.quote: Together, Thalia and Sigardia bested the fused sisters.

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin walks through Olivia Voldaren's masked ballroom to confront her.
timeline.quote: A hundred or more pairs of eyes watched him from behind elegant masks as he made his way across the ballroom.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia mocks Sorin and orders him thrown out, saying the scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome.
timeline.quote: The scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome here

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia he has come for her help.
timeline.quote: I have come for your help.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia that his grandfather's manor is in ruins; Olivia blames Avacyn and says she destroyed Castle Falkenrath.
timeline.quote: She's already destroyed Castle Falkenrath and scattered that bloodline.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin tells Olivia he created Avacyn to protect the world, and that a dangerous person has come to threaten it.
timeline.quote: I created her to be this world's protector.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin asks Olivia to summon her bloodline to join the Markov remnants against the threat.
timeline.quote: Summon the might of your bloodline, Olivia.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia agrees to help Sorin, on the condition that he first helps her.
timeline.quote: I will help you. But first you will help me.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: A vampire priest turns Liliana away until Olivia appears and welcomes her.
timeline.quote: Oh Liliana, my dear one!

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia rejoices that Avacyn is dead, a smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.
timeline.quote: A smear on the floor of Thraben Cathedral.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia says whoever opened the Helvault released more than the archangel, including another being now angry.
timeline.quote: set loose more than just the archangel

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia and Sorin accuse Liliana of freeing the Lithomancer.
timeline.quote: You released the Lithomancer and brought this upon us.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia calls Sorin outside, saying Nahiri awaits.
timeline.quote: Join me outside. Nahiri awaits.

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin and Olivia lead the Voldaren vampire army off to battle Nahiri, not to help the people.
timeline.quote: The vampire army marched off down the hill, swords and pikes and red-hot priest symbols held high

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia arrives overhead with vampire knights and says she cannot allow Nahiri her revenge.
timeline.quote: But he's also earned my help, so I can't allow you your revenge.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's ring of ley stones renders her invisible to the monsters, which instead attack the vampires.
timeline.quote: These monsters were blind to her within her ring of ley stones.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia and her vampires wade into the monsters while Sorin pursues Nahiri through the floating ruins.
timeline.quote: By the time Nahiri was among the unmoored, broken remnants of the manor's vaulted ceiling, Sorin was on her heels.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia taunts Sorin, declares the bargain fulfilled, and leaves him trapped.
timeline.quote: Avacyn is dead. Nahiri has been driven off. Our bargain is fulfilled.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia pushes Sorin's sword against his cheek and floats away, leaving him in stone.
timeline.quote: you're where you are. I think it's quite good.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren parleys with Thalia in midair, offering common cause against the horrors.
timeline.quote: I'm Olivia Voldaren, lady of Lurenbraum and progenitor of the Voldaren line.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia and Olivia agree that vampires and humans will not harm each other until the fight is over.
timeline.quote: No vampire bite or blade will draw human blood until this fight is through, Heir of Saint Traft.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia stabs Seeta, chief of the Sinpurged, from behind.
timeline.quote: Then she saw a jagged blade burst out from Seeta's chest

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia's army marched from Lurenbraum Fortress.
timeline.quote: Olivia's army marched from Lurenbraum Fortress

citation.text: Dusk Feaster (Eldritch Moon, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Emrakul arrives on Innistrad; Sorin is beaten and encased in stone by Nahiri, then abandoned by Olivia, who takes his sword.
timeline.quote: where he was bested by the Lithomancer and encased in stone

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Thraben Sigarda slays Brisela, and Jace and Tamiyo imprison Emrakul in the Moon of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren and Tamiyo imprisoned Emrakul within the Moon of Innistrad

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin finds Markov Manor ruined by Nahiri and seeks vampire allies, including Olivia Voldaren.
timeline.quote: Nahiri had left this declaration in stone as a warning of her vengeance.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys the corrupted Avacyn in Thraben Cathedral to secure Olivia's help.
timeline.quote: Sorin was forced to unmake his corrupted guardian in the same spot where she was born.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nahiri defeats Sorin and encases him in stone; Olivia takes his sword and declares herself lord of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: where he was bested by the Lithomancer and encased in stone

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Feuer wakes Olivia Voldaren to report that the humans are holding a festival to restore the balance of day and night.
timeline.quote: They're up to something. Trying to restore the balance of day and night, I believe.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Feuer reports that he burned a vampire effigy, saw Arlinn Kord leading the search, and learned that the humans seem to have the Moonsilver Key.
timeline.quote: I recognized their leader. Arlinn Kord

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia decides to let the festival proceed, saying never to interrupt someone doing your work for you.
timeline.quote: Never interrupt someone when they're doing your work for you.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Harvesttide" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia ambushes a ritualist and sends a wedding invitation.
timeline.quote: I'll send you an invitation to my wedding.

citation.text: Olivia's Midnight Ambush (Innistrad: Midnight Hunt, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual and takes the Key, and the Eternal Night begins.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren appeared, interrupting the ritual and taking the Key with her

citation.text: "Adeline", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn throws the Key to Olivia to save Katilda, beginning the Eternal Night.
timeline.quote: Deciding quickly, Arlinn threw the Key to the vampire, and Olivia hurled Katilda's body to the ground.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the witches' ritual and takes the Moonsilver Key, beginning the Eternal Night.
timeline.quote: Thus, the Eternal Night began.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual, takes the Key, and drops Katilda; Arlinn cannot save her and the Eternal Night begins.
timeline.quote: This left the ritual unfinished, and the Eternal Night a fact.

citation.text: "Dawnhart Coven", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual and takes the Key, leaving the ritual unfinished and the Eternal Night a fact.
timeline.quote: but Olivia Voldaren appeared to interrupt the ritual again and took the Key with her.

citation.text: "Harvesttide Festival", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren disturbs the Dawnhart ritual, begins the Eternal Night, captures Sigarda and plans to marry Edgar Markov to control the bloodlines.
timeline.quote: Olivia sought to take control over the vampiric bloodlines by marrying the charmed Edgar Markov

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Reign of Olivia Voldaren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and the coven's spirit foil Olivia, who flees; the ritual ends the Eternal Night.
timeline.quote: caused the Eternal Night to end and the sun to rise again, ending Olivia's scheme

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Reign of Olivia Voldaren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia interrupts the ritual, uses Katilda as hostage, takes the Key and hurls Katilda to the ground.
timeline.quote: After Olivia obtained the Key she launched Katilda towards the ground

citation.text: "Katilda", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren takes the Key, beginning the Eternal Night.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren appeared and interrupted the ritual by taking the Key with her

citation.text: "Kaya Cassir", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and the Gatewatch recover the Moonsilver Key from Olivia Voldaren with Sorin's help.
timeline.quote: Arlinn and the Gatewatch managed to recover the Moonsilver Key from Olivia Voldaren

citation.text: "Moon of Innistrad", section "Eternal Night". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Katilda offers her soul into the Key, but Olivia Voldaren interrupts the ritual and takes the Key.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren appeared and interrupted the ritual by taking the Key with her.

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sorin's attack on Olivia awakens Katilda's spirit from the Key, which frees the captive Sigarda.
timeline.quote: used her powers to free Sigarda

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia holds Katilda hostage and takes the Moonsilver Key from Arlinn's party.
timeline.quote: Olivia swept down from the skies and held Katilda hostage, demanding the Moonsilver Key from the assembled party.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Teferi's group retrieves the Moonsilver Key from Markov Manor with Sigarda's help but Olivia Voldaren steals it and the Eternal Night begins.
timeline.quote: Thus, the Eternal Night began.

citation.text: "Teferi Akosa", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Battle of Thraben a coalition of vampires, the Order of Saint Traft, the Gatewatch and zombies defeat Emrakul's Eldrazi and Nahiri's cultists after Sigarda kills Brisela; Emrakul is imprisoned in Innistrad's Moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was imprisoned within Innistrad's Moon

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren crashes down in a streak of red and gold, seizes Katilda and reaches for the key; Arlinn dives and secures it.
timeline.quote: Katilda swallowed up in its impossible color.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia offers to trade Katilda for the key and cuts her chest to force a decision.
timeline.quote: she rakes her claws across Katilda's chest.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The witches say the ritual had to be done by Katilda, so Arlinn throws the key to Olivia.
timeline.quote: Arlinn hurls the key with her good arm.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia throws Katilda toward the altar, injuring them both, and flies away with the key.
timeline.quote: By the time the world stops spinning, the vampire is gone.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Night Closes 'Round" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Weeks after the Harvesttide Massacre, Grigori draws blood from his sleeping mother to meet Olivia Voldaren's tithe decree.
timeline.quote: Grigori presses the knife to his mother's wrist.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia's decree demands one bowl of blood from every resident each night until the festivities.
timeline.quote: one bowl of blood from each resident, once a night until the festivities

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin crushes a bat carrying an envelope addressed to him and recognizes the handwriting.
timeline.quote: He crushes it without a second thought.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the invitation to Olivia Voldaren's wedding and that she has stolen Edgar; if they marry she will rule all of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: "She's stolen my grandfather.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren makes a grand entrance, announces the wedding and has thralls carry in a coffin for the groom.
timeline.quote: an elaborate stone coffin: marble inlaid with gold, crowned by Markovian rays

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin walks through the estate escorted by guards and reflects that Olivia chose a political marriage with his grandfather.
timeline.quote: It was only natural that someone so nakedly ambitious would hit on the idea of a political marriage.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin is announced in the ballroom and sees his grandfather's coffin on the dais.
timeline.quote: There's no mistaking it: that is his grandfather's coffin.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia cuts her arm to let her blood drip into Edgar's coffin to wake him.
timeline.quote: Old blood, potent blood, blood dark as the night around them, drips onto Edgar Markov's coffin.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin charges at Olivia, killing one guard and freezing two, but is bound with Blessed Silver chains by the guards.
timeline.quote: When Sorin pounces on one, he tears out their throat before the two of them even hit the ground.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov wakes, drinks Olivia's blood and is presented as her betrothed; he dismisses Sorin's warnings.
timeline.quote: "I present to you my handsome, perfect betrothed: Lord Edgar Markov."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia wakes other Markov ancients for the groom's side, and Sorin's family passes him by without a word.
timeline.quote: A few drops is all it takes to start the process of waking the ancients.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin, chained, studies Olivia's stained-glass window and reflects that her life has marched toward this moment of seized power.
timeline.quote: The larger picture of Olivia's life has always marched toward this.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia welcomes the guests and promises a present for Edgar before the wedding.
timeline.quote: I have a little something else planned first.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The curtains fall to reveal Sigarda bound with red ribbons as a living gift.
timeline.quote: There is no cage save Sigarda's own wings

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin works out that Olivia plans to control angels by drinking Sigarda's blood bound with the Moonsilver Key and Sungold lock.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren with control over all the angels in Innistrad.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The false priest begins the ceremony, and Olivia speaks vows to Edgar that mock him.
timeline.quote: And I promise to grant you the honor of being my husband.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin uses blood magic to cut his chains and objects to the wedding.
